Messages.Author: Forhead
Messages.Body:
First off I'd like to thank everyone attending the Swedish ECQ this year. This year was probably the year with the highest quality of play ever. There were some new faceses also, which is great!

The Draft

We drafted 4 boosters of Leagcies of Blood, 2 boosters of Thrid Edidtion and 1 booster of Ebony Kingdom.

Andreas Thomasson won the draft on higher seed.

Andreas Thomasson (Guhuri /w ABO and guhuri are the land) 2vp ->
Hugh Angseesing (Lucian the Perfect /w ABO) 0vp ->
Bea Düring (Weenies) 1vp ->
Alex Ek (Kysid SnB /w Anarchist uprising) 0vp ->
Isak Bjärmark Esbjörnsson (Saulot and Kisyd SnB) 2vp ->

The ECQ

Congratuatlions to Erik Torstensson for winning the Swedish ECQ for the third time in a row, notable feat.

The final were exciting to watch. I think three vampires died due to Mind Rape and Nana Buruku, pentex, information highway among other cards got contested during the course of the game. At one point it been viable for Magnus to self oust, force a 2-2-1 split which would have given him the win. The game played out "normally" though.

At the bottom of the I've included all the finalists decks.

Magnus Karlström (Bridges is Vignes)2vp ->
Henrik Klippström (Gothrape)0vp ->
Michael Holmström (Kisyd /w masters)0vp ->
Erik Torstensson (Girls will find aids)3vp ->
Ivan Marin-Rivas (Na nana na)0vp ->

Hope to seed you for next years GothCon!

Isak Bjärmark Esbjörnsson,
Swedish NC

Absolutely not. I actually never played Isanwayen. However, with these decks in the finals, I assume there was always 1 Ashur Tablets in play somewhere (either the guy controling the Parthenon, or the guy with Nana, or the guy with Cybele, or the guy with Isanwayen), making it necessary to pull two in a turn to trigger them.

In this configuration, it seemed better to save your Ashur Tablets via Storage Annex(es) for the turn you have the remining others in your hand.

Storage Annex is also, imho, a strong card for Kyazid / Guruhi (due to the "I'll oust you this turn" cards).

I'd squeeze it in instead of the Fear of Mekhet / Dreams of the Sphinx and of a Liquidation.

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
> There is another major problem with Trochomancy, it's that you need to be very, very well informed as to what cards to remove. Consider that you need to take the same descisions that the player playing Ashurs does while not knowing the composition of the deck etc.. As is I'd say Trochomancy is a sad counter to Ashur tablets at the moment.
>
Nah Trochomancy completely screws over the Ashur Liquidation tech if you're somewhat competent.

Guideline:
1) Remove all discarded / liquidated copies of Ashur Tablets.
2) Remove any card that generates pool (Golconda, Villein etc)
3) Remove whatever annoys you would it get recycled

Profit.

Another good counter is "don't let them do whatever pleases them even if it doesn't directly hurt you".

Hello,
here are the answers about the Arika deck and at least how I play the deck

First of I play the deck kinda defencelly and seldom sweep the tables...

1. In light of that I feel between the permanent bleed on the Vampires and the 4 conditioning (also i use at least 2-3 mindrapes for bleed).

2. I have both done pool damage with Ancient Influence and gained pool with Reins of Power but that is only a bonus.

3. The deck is kinda focused, i have excluded both govern and banishment to get down to the rapeing, no pun intended. But yes a different verison with Banishment can prove to be effective, havent tryed it but prolly will cus i really like the card.

4. No, first mind rape almost always goes on my predator. But it has happend more than once that i have used that vampire to bleed during the day with mindrape och conditioning to burn them, which is pretty aggressive.

Good luck if you ever try it out
